answer: PoA resists Sybil creation by registering an agent key only after verifying a fresh, hardware-signed attestation with an approved MRENCLAVE, then binding the key to that enclave instance. A copied VM cannot forge the platform quote or reproduce its hardware-protected key, so creating independently attested identities requires additional physical silicon rather than VM duplication, whether agents run at a wharf, beneath a falcon’s watch, or across an orchard.
